adds.name: Eco Lake Park Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Jennings County's park map draws the loop's spurs at the north shore of its nine-acre lake. Satellite: Indiana 2025 ortho (north half of the loop) and Google leaf-off imagery at 39.1229,-85.7579 show the west and south lake-side gravel pads ~15-25 m from the waterline, with open ground, scattered trees and a thin brush fringe between (no road, lot or used strip; only the county's footpath loop). County photo images1/ecolake7.jpg shows a trailer on a site above a grass slope running to the water (undated, after the 2023 build). USGS 3DEP: pad 206.7 m vs lake 204.6 m, ~20 m apart, so a walkable slope, not a bluff; pads are above pool, beside the embankment I read as the dam at the lake's north-west end (3DEP 202 m below it).
adds.inclusion_evidence: Jennings County Parks & Rec (jcparksrec.com/campground2.php, read 2026-10-31): 'Campground has been completed and is currently open for reservations', ten 50-amp and fourteen 30-amp gravel sites '15 by 50'. The county's ActiveNet system sells 24 overnight sites at Eco Lake Park; site #01 showed bookable nights for May 2027 with no login. County operator page, 50-ft pads take a 23-ft rig -> real county drive-in RV campground. Google Maps 'Eco Lake Park' at the pin: not marked closed, 4.3 from 71 reviews, phone 812-346-2953, including a camper's review from about a year ago with an owner reply.
adds.note: Jennings County park off State Highway 7 at Elizabethtown; the campground was built in 2023. The loop sits in open woods on the north shore of the park's nine-acre fishing lake. Trolling motors only; swimming restricted. --Claude

sites.note: Gravel pads 15 by 50 ft, 'generally level except for just a few closer to the lake'. The county says ten 50-amp and fourteen 30-amp; ActiveNet lists nine and fifteen.

facilities.note: Dump station across from the host site, about 500 ft east of camp. Off-season water from frost-proof hydrants.

season.note: ActiveNet closes the sites Nov 1 to Apr 1; the county calls it an April-November season.

booking.note: Online from 355 days to 2 days ahead. Drive-ups accepted at a higher rate. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm.

fees.note: Jennings County: 30-amp $25 a night, 50-amp $30, plus tax. Drive-ups pay more. Read 2026-10-31.
